normalization: sum(weight * mean_answer_and_eos_token_loss) / sum(weights) within each effective batch
rare_definition: Frozen per-task training-label frequency <= 0.10, including absent labels; existing examples only
sampling: natural_frequency; original epoch-three order; no oversampling
promising_rule: rare recall strictly exceeds control and primary question_macro_f1 is no lower; report precision and paired agreement CI regardless
budget: One alternative third epoch, plus smoke/resume checks and one full validation; no further epochs auto-launched
weight_rationale: Moderate engineering choice fixed before either third-epoch validation result; not a published Qwen optimum
execution: Wait for normal epoch-three validation and complete checkpoint, preserve original run, then run serially on existing capped RTX 3090
